title: Authentic Brands treats the Super Bowl like ‘a business summit.’ It’s hosting a private weekend for executive meetings, ad panels and a brand showcase
description: The company behind SI The Party and Shaq’s Fun House is taking over all 180 rooms at the Waldorf Astoria Beverly Hills, with Kevin Hart, David Beckham, and Shaq set to attend.
content: For Authentic Brands Group , whose brands drive more than $38 billion in global annual systemwide sales, Super Bowl weekend has as much to do with business as it does with football. Recommended Video Authentic’s roster spans more than 50 brands, ranging from Reebok, Sports Illustrated, and Care Bears to Shaquille O’Neal, David Beckham, and Kevin Hart, and it’s taking over the Waldorf Astoria Beverly Hills from Feb. 11-13, 2027, Authentic told Fortune exclusively. The three-day, invite-only event called Authentic House will fill the hotel’s 170 guest rooms and more than 20 programming spaces with executive meetings, conversations with chief marketing officers about Super Bowl ads, and a presentation of Authentic’s brands and upcoming projects. “For us, Super Bowl is more than just a game. It’s like a business summit and a hospitality experience,” Corey Salter , CEO of entertainment at Authentic, told Fortune . “We’re just really trying to create our own headquarters for the biggest weekend in sports.” Authentic House was created by Authentic Live , the company’s experiences division, which is also behind Shaq’s Fun House and SI: The Party . Authentic Live hosted more than 50 events in 2025, drawing about 65,000 attendees, 324 million social impressions, and more than 35 billion media impressions. In 2026, the division hosted 58 entertainment events with about 70,000 attendees, generating 643.3 million impressions and 64.4 billion media impressions, which the company attributed partly to the success of O’Neal’s Dunkman . Authentic Live plans to host more than 90 events in 2027. The company declined to disclose revenue. From ticketed parties to a private hotel Unlike those ticketed events, Authentic House is invite-only. Salter said guests won’t be able to just “come buy a table.” Fewer than 300 people will stay at the hotel, he estimated, while likely more than 5,000 will come through over the weekend. The concept for Authentic House started small. Earlier this year in San Francisco, Authentic took over Quince , a three-Michelin-star restaurant. That version included a live recording of The Big Podcast with Shaq featuring Bo Jackson and Barry Sanders, along with the SI Swimsuit Digital Cover Party. Guests included Hart, 50 Cent, Ciara, and Russell Wilson. “We took a leap of faith, and it worked incredibly,” Salter said. But that restaurant only seated about 120 people, Salter said, so Authentic decided to “take a much bigger swing” this year. “We believe that content drives commerce,” Salter said. “Our entertainment and lifestyle brands overlap a lot, and we’re in the entertainment capital of the world in Los Angeles.” Victory Creative Group But taking over the hotel “was not free,” Salter said. Authentic will host clients and partners in some rooms and sell others to partners. Authentic also has category-exclusive partnerships at Authentic House, which the company said are curated to offer partners “opportunities and access to tastemakers and decision makers across business, entertainment, media and, culture.” The company did not disclose the cost of partnerships. “Success for us is really making sure that we throw incredible events, that we have a very well-occupied space with good people and good celebrities and good sports people around,” Salter said, adding partners from China, Turkey, Latin America and Australia are expected to attend. Ultimately, Salter said, the company looks at what it calls total deal value, with the goal of building long-term partnerships. “It’s not about a quick dollar,” he said. Programming will include an invite-only dinner hosted by Authentic founder and executive chairman, Jamie Salter, as well as the Authentic Showcase, which Corey Salter called “our version of the upfronts,” the annual events where media companies pitch upcoming programming to advertisers. USA TODAY will host an Ad Meter Summit with CMOs and its editors, and a Style Studio will let influencers and creators shop brands such as Reebok, Champion, and Juicy Couture. There will also be a Sports Illustrated Swimsuit digital cover launch and a Care Bears Family Day on the rooftop, since over Super Bowl weekend “there’s really nothing for children and families to do,” Corey Salter said. “Imagine a very overpriced, very expensive birthday party that you would want to do for your kids… and then times it by 10, and that’s what you’re going to see up there,” he added. Hart, Beckham, and O’Neal are expected to attend, along with a lineup of notable athletes, entertainers, and other talent. Outside the hotel, SI The Party will be held in Century City and Shaq’s Fun House downtown. Authentic’s and partners’ brands will also appear throughout the hotel, including in minibars and guest rooms, at a cafe by the entrance and in a gifting suite, Salter said. “It’s not going to be like in-your-face branding,” he said, “but it’s going to be really, really nice touchpoints.” Fortune Daily breaks the traditional barrier between audience and newsroom.
